questions.stem: To make the students active and relaxed, Mr. Li often tells funny ________ to make them laugh.
questions.expl: 句意：为了让学生们活跃和放松，李老师经常讲有趣的笑话来逗他们笑。 考查名词辨析。jokes 笑话；facts 事实；results 结果；meals 餐。根据下文“to make them laugh”可知， 是讲有趣的笑话逗他们笑。故选A。

questions.stem: We ________ each other since I came to Beijing but we send emails very often.
questions.expl: 句意：自从我来北京后，我们就没见过面，但我们经常发电子邮件。 考查现在完成时。根据“since I came to Beijing”可知，此处时态为现在完成时have/has done，表示 动作从过去开始，并持续到现在。故选B。

questions.stem: —Why are you so happy?—All of us succeed the final exam.
questions.expl: 句意：——你为什么这么高兴?——我们所有人都成功地通过了期末考试。 考查动词短语辨析。succeed in 成功做某事，介词in 后接动名词短语；pass 动词，通过。根据句意 结构，可知选A。

questions.stem: Lucy failed ________ on time and missed the class.
questions.expl: 句意：露西没能准时到达，错过了这节课。 考查非谓语动词。根据“Lucy failed…on time”可知，此处指“未能准时到达”，fail to do sth.“未能做 某事”，动词短语，后接动词不定式作宾语。故选D。

questions.stem: Trees can help reduce air pollution.That’s true. __, they can make the city cooler in hot summer.
questions.expl: 句意：树木有助于减少空气污染。那是真的。此外，他们可以使城市在炎热的夏天更凉爽。 A. However(1)然而，表转折关系，一般用逗号与主句隔开；(2)不管怎样，无论如何，引导一个

questions.stem: We go to school every day _____ Saturday and Sunday.
questions.expl: 句意：除了星期六和星期日，我们每天都上学。本句子是考查besides 和except 的用法， besides 表示“包含在内”；except 表示“不包含在内”。except for 是指主体的细节除外，和主体不是 同类，所以排除。结合句意可知，这里是不包括星期六和星期天的。故选C。

questions.stem: The box is full ______ eggs. Who filled it _______ the eggs?
questions.expl: 句意：这个箱子装满了鸡蛋。谁用鸡蛋把它装满的？ 考查固定搭配的用法。be full of 充满……；fill…with…用……充满……。结合题干第一空是箱子里 装满了鸡蛋，所以用介词of，第二空是用鸡蛋把箱子装满，所以用with。故选C。

questions.stem: She likes ________, but she never ________ others.
questions.expl: 句意：她喜欢讲笑话，但是从来不取笑其他人。 考查动词短语。tell jokes 讲笑话；say jokes 表述错误；make fun of sb 取笑某人；play fun of sb 表述 错误。like doing sth“喜欢做某事”，所以第一空填telling jokes；主语是“She”，后面谓语要和前面“likes” 一致，由“but”可知她从不对某人开玩笑，故选B。

questions.stem: He’s really _________ after the _________ tennis match.
questions.expl: 句意：在累人的网球比赛后他真的累了。 考查形容词辨析。tiring“令人疲倦的”，用于描述事物或活动本身的特性；tired“感到疲倦的”，用于 描述人的感受。第一空，主语是“He” (人)，且表示比赛后他的状态，应使用“tired”表示“他感到疲 倦”，排除A 和D；第二空，修饰“tennis match” (事物)，表示比赛本身的特性，应使用“tiring”表示 “比赛令人疲倦”，排除C。故选B。

questions.stem: Our soccer team ________ all the other football teams and ________ first prize last weekend.
questions.expl: 句意：我们的足球队上周末击败了所有其他足球队并获得了一等奖。 考查动词辨析和动词时态。beat 打败，对象一般是人或队伍；win 赢，对象一般是比赛，奖项。第 一空对象是其他足球队，应用beat；第二空对象是奖项，应用win。结合“last weekend”可知句子是 一般过去时，故选A。 二、完形填空(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，满分10 分) A wealthy man loved his son very much. As he wanted his son to live a happy life, he decided to send him to see a wise old man for his advice on happiness. When the old man learnt about his 11, he handed the boy an empty bowl and said, “Go to the river miles away and 12 it with water. I will tell you about it 13 no water is spilt (洒) when you get here.” Although the boy was very surprised at this, he had no choice but to 14 this task. The boy set off on foot for the river and some time later came back with a bowl of water. The old man asked him, “Did you notice the beautiful flowers 15 the road and the birds singing in the trees?” The boy could say nothing about them because he gave his 16 attention to the bowl in his hands. The old man smiled and said, “Bring me 17 bowl of water, but this time enjoy the flowers and the singing of birds as well.” When he returned, the boy was able to 18 everything he had seen to the old man. But when he looked down at his bowl, he 19 found that most water was gone. He forgot all about his bowl while enjoying the beautiful things along the road. “Well, young man,” the old man said. “Enjoy the beauty of the world, but never forget the water in your bowl. This is the 20 to happiness.”

questions.stem: A．wish
questions.expl: ：当老人了解到他的愿望后，递给男孩一个空碗并说道：“去几英里外的河边，把碗装满 水。” wish 愿望；promise 承诺；research 研究；experience 经历。根据前文“he wanted his son to live a happy life, he decided to send him to see a wise old man for his advice on happiness”可知，男孩来的目的是请 教幸福的秘诀，这是他的愿望，wish 符合语境。故选A。

questions.stem: A．wash
questions.expl: ：当老人了解到他的愿望后，递给男孩一个空碗并说道：“去几英里外的河边，把碗装满 水。” wash 洗；fill 装满；compare 比较；connect 连接。根据“an empty bowl”和“with water”可知，空碗需 要装满水，fill…with…表示“用……装满……”，固定短语。故选B。

questions.stem: A．while
questions.expl: ：如果你回来时水没有洒出来，我就告诉你。 while 当……时；until 直到；unless 除非；if 如果。根据“I will tell you about it” 和“no water is spilt (洒) when you get here.”可知，水没洒出来是告诉秘诀的条件，if 引导条件状语从句。故选D。

questions.stem: A．carry out
questions.expl: ：虽然男孩对此很惊讶，但他别无选择，只能执行这项任务。 carry out 执行；pick out 挑选；point out 指出；bring out 使显现。根据“this task”可知，男孩需要执 行老人安排的打水任务。故选A。

questions.stem: A．in
questions.expl: ：老人问他：“你有没有注意到沿途的美丽花朵和树上唱歌的小鸟？” in 在……里；along 沿着；with 和……一起；between 在……之间。根据“the road”可知，花朵是沿 着道路生长的。故选B。

questions.stem: A．public
questions.expl: ：男孩对此无话可说，因为他把全部注意力都放在了手中的碗上。 public 公共的；weak 虚弱的；full 全部的；fast 快的。根据“The boy could say nothing about them”可 知，男孩没注意到花朵和小鸟，是因为把全部注意力都放在了碗上，full attention 表示“全部注意力”。 故选C。

questions.stem: A．another
questions.expl: ：老人笑着说：“再去给我打一碗水，但这次也要欣赏花朵和小鸟的歌声。” another 另一个，三者及以上中的；every 每个；any 任何；the other 另一个，两者中的。根据前文 男孩已经打了一碗水，此处指再打一碗，是三者及以上场景中的另一个。故选A。

questions.stem: A．change
questions.expl: ：当他回来时，男孩能够向老人描述他所看到的一切。 change 改变；imagine 想象；examine 检查；describe 描述。根据“everything he had seen”可知，男孩 看到了沿途的风景，需要向老人描述这些内容。故选D。

questions.stem: A．lazily
questions.expl: ：但当他低头看碗时，悲伤地发现大部分水都洒了。 lazily 懒惰地；sadly 悲伤地；luckily 幸运地；excitedly 兴奋地。根据“most water was gone”可知， 水洒了，男孩应是悲伤的。故选B。

questions.stem: A．result
questions.expl: ：这就是幸福的秘诀。 result 结果；show 展示；secret 秘诀；decision 决定。根据前文“he decided to send him to see a wise old man for his advice on happiness”可知，男孩来的目的是请教幸福的秘诀，此处老人给出答案。故选 C。 三、阅读理解(本大题共15 小题，每小题2 分，满分30 分) A Chinese folk stories have long been a source of wisdom and inspiration, carrying timeless lessons through great stories. Among there, here are three stories stand out for their touching and inspiring characters. Yu Gong, an old man decided to move two huge mountains stopping his village’s road. Though being laughed at and told it was impossible, Yu Gong kept trying, believing that even if he couldn’t complete it, his family would continue the effort. His story teaches us the power of fighting for something and the importance of setting good examples for the other people. Hou Yi, a skilled archer who saves humans from the scorching heat of ten suns by shooting down nine of them. This act of bravery not only cools the earth but also highlights the actions to protect our world and the people we care about. Hou Yi’s story inspires us to face the challenges with courage and skill. In this story, the sky fell down, causing problems on Earth, NǚWā, a kind goddess, decided to fix the sky to save the world. She collected stones from a river and used them to rebuild the sky. Also, she killed a huge turtle to use its legs as pillars to support the sky. Her actions returned peace and order to the world. 21．What’s the lesson from Yu Gong’s story? A．Moving the village. B．Trying the best. C．Laughing at people. D．Fighting for food. 22．Hou Yi shot down nine suns because of _________. A．a falling sky B．two huge mountains C．the cooling earth D．the high heat 23．What’s the most important thing for Nǚ Wā? A．Some light. B．Some mountains. C．Some stones. D．Some water.

questions.stem: What’s the lesson from Yu Gong’s story?
Hou Yi shot down nine suns because of _________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Hou Yi, a skilled archer who saves humans from the scorching heat of ten suns by shooting down nine of them.”可知，后羿射掉9 个太阳是因为高温。故选D。

questions.stem: What’s the most important thing for Nǚ Wā?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“She collected stones from a river and used them to rebuild the sky.”可知，石头 对女娲很重要。故选C。

questions.stem: What do the characters have in common?
opts: They were from the rich family of ancient times.
They used their own super power to save the world.
They were brave to overcome the difficulties in life.
They followed their leaders and solved the problems.
questions.expl: 判断题。通读全文可知，愚公移山克服大山阻碍，后羿射日克服高温威胁，女娲补天克服 天空坠落的难题，他们都勇敢地克服了生活中的困难。故选C。

questions.stem: Which part of the library is the passage probably from?
questions.expl: 判断题。本文主要讲述的是中国民间故事，可能来自古代书籍中。故选B。

questions.stem: What can we learn about the Dragon Gate?
opts: Hou Yi made it with his sword.
It was a good place full of magic.
The Yangtze River ran through it.
It was a real gate only for carps.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“It was called the Dragon Gate, a place with magic.”可知，龙门是一个充满魔 力的好地方。故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following words can best describe the carps according to Paragraph 3?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Although the carps (鲤鱼) in the river were small, still they were not afraid. They tried to jump over the waves toward the Dragon Gate without fear. ”可知，鲤鱼不害怕、无畏尝试，体 现了“勇敢”的特点。故选D。

questions.stem: What happened to the little carp after getting to the Dragon Gate?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“He was not a fish anymore!”以及“The little carp had turned into a golden dragon!” 可知，鲤鱼变成了金龙，故选A。

questions.stem: Which is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Only the little golden carp was good at jumping.
The little carp knew a lot about the Dragon Gate.
It’s difficult for the carp to get to the Dragon Gate.
Most carps succeeded in jumping across the Dragon Gate.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“The carps began to jump, but one after another they began to fall. They tried but couldn’t get to the Dragon Gate.”可知，其他鲤鱼纷纷失败，证明难度高。故选C。

questions.stem: What’s the best title of the passage?
opts: Where There Is a Will, There Is a Way
questions.expl: 标题题。通读全文可知，故事核心是小鲤鱼坚持跳跃最终化龙，寓意“有志者事竟成”。故 选D。 C Ancient China amazed the world with its wisdom. Some of its inventions continue to influence us today. Four Chinese irrigation sites (灌溉点) were added to the 2018 list of World Heritage Irrigation Structures (世界灌溉工程遗产). Let’s take a look at these amazing sites. Dujiangyan Dujiangyan is a wonder in the world history of irrigation structures. More than 2,000 years ago, Chengdu was in danger because of flood from the Minjiang River. Li Bing, a local official, designed the Dujiangyan irrigation system, which could control the water run from the mountains to the Chengdu Plain all year round. Changqu Canal Changqu Canal, also known as Baiqi Canal, is in the city of Xiangyang in Hubei Province. It is 48 km long in total and it was first used to transport soldiers. It was later used for irrigation-in fact, it is still used to provide water to more than 30,000 mu (20 square km) of farmland. Lingqu Canal Located in Xing’an County, Guangxi, Lingqu Canal was built 2,000 years ago. It is the oldest canal in the world. It was built to transport things for the army. “It magically lowers the pressure of transportation along the north and south waterways,” according to the Travel China Guide. It also turned Xing’an into an agriculturally (农业上) developed area. Jiang-Xi Dam

questions.stem: Which was built to fight against water?
Which is TRUE about Changqu Canal?
opts: It is also called Baiqi Canal.
It is still important for the army.
It was first built for the farmland.
It was later used to transport soldiers.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Changqu Canal, also known as Baiqi Canal, is in the city of Xiangyang in Hubei Province.”可知，长渠也被称为白起渠。故选A。

questions.stem: What can we know about Lingqu Canal?
opts: Why and how it was built.
When and why it was built.
When and how it was built.
Where and how it was built.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Located in Xing’an county, Cuangxi Prwivce, Lingqu Canal was built 2,000 years ago. It is the oldest canal in the world. It was built to transport things for the army.”可知，灵渠建于2000 年前，建造目的是为军队运输物资。故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the youngest irrigation system?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Built in the 14th century, it improved life for local people for centuries.”可知， 姜席堰建于14 世纪，是四个灌溉工程中最年轻的。故选C。

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of the passage?
opts: To give advice on controlling the water.
To show ancient Chinese wisdom to the word.
To introduce the long and rich Chinese history.
To introduce how four Chinese irrigation sites was built.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据全文内容可知，本文主要介绍了四个中国古代灌溉工程遗产，展示了中国古 代的智慧和对世界的影响。故选B。
